title_vi: before / after / during / while (trước / sau / trong suốt / trong khi)
theory_html:
A. before, during and after

A. before, during và after

before the film / during the film / after the film

trước bộ phim / trong lúc chiếu phim / sau bộ phim

  • Everybody feels nervous before exams.

    Ai cũng hồi hộp trước kỳ thi.

  • I fell asleep during the film.

    Tôi ngủ gật trong lúc xem phim.

  • We were tired after our visit to the museum.

    Chúng tôi mệt sau chuyến tham quan bảo tàng.

B. before, while and after

B. before, while và after

before we played / while we were playing / after we played

trước khi chúng tôi chơi / trong khi chúng tôi đang chơi / sau khi chúng tôi chơi

  • Don’t forget to close the window before you go out.

    Đừng quên đóng cửa sổ trước khi bạn ra ngoài.

  • I often fall asleep while I’m reading.

    Tôi hay ngủ gật trong khi đọc sách.

  • They went home after they did the shopping.

    Họ về nhà sau khi mua sắm xong.

C. during, while and for

C. during, while và for

We use during + noun (during the film). We use while + verb (while I’m reading):

Dùng during + danh từ (during the film). Dùng while + động từ (while I’m reading):

  • We didn’t speak during the meal.

    Chúng tôi không nói chuyện trong bữa ăn.

  • but We didn’t speak while we were eating. (not during we were eating)

    nhưng Chúng tôi không nói chuyện trong khi ăn. (không nói during we were eating)

Use for (not during) + a period of time (three days / two hours / a year etc.):

Dùng for (không dùng during) + một khoảng thời gian (three days / two hours / a year v.v.):

  • We played tennis for two hours. (not during two hours)

    Chúng tôi chơi quần vợt hai tiếng. (không nói during two hours)

  • I lived in London for a year. (not during a year)

    Tôi sống ở London một năm. (không nói during a year)

D. before/after + -ing

You can use before/after + -ing (before going / after eating etc.):

Có thể dùng before/after + -ing (before going / after eating v.v.):

  • I always have breakfast before going to work. (= before I go to work)

    Tôi luôn ăn sáng trước khi đi làm. (= before I go to work)

  • After doing the shopping, they went home. (= after they did)

    Sau khi mua sắm xong, họ về nhà. (= after they did)

We say before going (not before to go), after doing (not after to do) etc.:

Nói before going (không nói before to go), after doing (không nói after to do) v.v.:

  • Before eating the apple, I washed it carefully. (not before to eat)

    Trước khi ăn quả táo, tôi rửa nó cẩn thận. (không nói before to eat)

  • I started work after reading the newspaper. (not after to read)

    Tôi bắt đầu làm việc sau khi đọc báo. (không nói after to read)
